expectations.text: States the mechanism: a cross-border transfer impact assessment (CPDTIA/CTIA) dossier submitted to A05/MPS within 60 days of first transfer (per Decree 356/2025)
expectations.evidence: "submitted to the Ministry of Public Security... within 60 days of the first transfer"; CPDTIA dossier described; cites "Decree 356 Article 12"

expectations.text: Mentions ongoing duties: periodic updates (6-monthly) and updates on material changes
expectations.evidence: "refreshed every six months, or immediately whenever there is a material change"

expectations.text: States the enforcement risk under Decree 330/2026: concealment/misdeclaration or assessment failures combined with breach/loss of citizens' data trigger the revenue-based fine bands (up to 3–5% of Vietnam-market revenue)
expectations.evidence: "under the now-operative Decree 330/2026/ND-CP... CPDTIA failure, concealment, or misdeclaration that results in an actual breach or loss of Vietnamese citizens' data is penalized as a percentage of your prior-year Vietnam-market revenue... 3–5%"

expectations.text: Distinguishes the lesser offence: plain failure to file/update the dossier carries fixed fines around VND 30–50M
expectations.evidence: "Simply failing to file the CPDTIA on time, or filing late updates, is treated as a plain procedural violation: VND 30–50 million"

expectations.text: Notes suspension of cross-border transfers as an available remedial measure
expectations.evidence: "the Ministry can order suspension of the cross-border transfer itself"
